desc: The Freedom Rail is VLTOR’s first standalone AR15 handguard. The Freedom Rail provides a forend that has an excellent strength-to-weight ratio. It is offered in various popular lengths, and is very quick and easy to install. The barrel nut and all necessary hardware for installation is included with each handguard. The VLTOR Freedom Rail features the M-Lok mounting system to accommodate all M-Lok and M-Lok-compatible accessories.
